principles: Fight at range first. Use the assigned bow and preserve spacing while the enemy crosses the killing ground.
Do not abandon bows merely because the enemy begins advancing; continue shooting until another volley would compromise ordered preparation for contact.
Before contact: bows away, long spear and shield ready, close ordered ranks, overlap shields, exploit spear reach, receive rather than rush, and counterthrust without breaking frontage.

If the spear is broken, lost, trapped by close penetration, unsuitable in confined ground, or formation depth collapses: pass back or discard the spear and fight with one-handed long sword and shield.
Core progression: BOW -> LONG SPEAR + SHIELD -> ONE-HANDED LONG SWORD + SHIELD.
Kill at distance. Deny entry with spear and shield. If the enemy penetrates the spear line, finish the fight with sword and shield.
doctrine.weapon_transition_rule: Core progression: BOW -> LONG SPEAR + SHIELD -> ONE-HANDED LONG SWORD + SHIELD.
